item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 19/Feb/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
With the northeast monsoon affecting Guangdong further moderating today, temperatures will rise over the coastal areas. A strong northeast monsoon is expected to affect the coast of southern China early to midweek this week. It will be windy with cool mornings over the region. Under the influence of a replenishment of the monsoon, it will remain cool in the morning over Guangdong in the latter part of this week. Besides, the area of low pressure over the seas east of the Philippines is expected to develop gradually today and tomorrow, and move in the general direction of Luzon.
